Heart; 3 Soul; Medium (50 ft); listed as melee. Ward: a targeted enemy that fails a CR 1 Heart Check spends its next Move Action retreating its full Move Distance straight away from you. Holy: counts as a Holy weapon.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.135

automation.note: Ward: the target makes a CR 1 Heart Check. On a failure its next Move Action must take it its full Move Distance directly away from the bearer.
